content: We are rebooting the regular Mathlib community meetings. The first one will be 2024-02-10T02:00:00+11:00 at https://meet.google.com/guj-dcde-cdq.

These meetings will alternate with the FRO community meetings: both will be at this time on the 2nd Friday, with Mathlib meetings in even months and FRO meetings in odd months.

(Of course, subject to change depending on enthusiasm and availability!)
Please continue discussion of this meeting at https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/113488-general/topic/Mathlib.20community.20meetings/near/419745898.

A reminder (hopefully I'm not double posting!) of the FRO community meeting at 2024-05-11T00:00:00+10:00 on meet.google.com/guj-dcde-cdq.
